questions.text: The MCP server's changes need a scope, and mcp isn't on the scopes list. Which scope should they use?

recommended.why: the MCP server only calls the booking API, so its change is a test there

others: Add mcp to the scopes list in the config first

questions.text: Should the quote lifetime be fixed at 24 hours in code, or a setting per deployment?

recommended.why: staging can test expiry in minutes, and changing it needs no release
